newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Fipe inflation 0.24 pct Jan 16 thru Feb 14.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Fipe inflation 0.24 pct Jan 16 thru Feb 14.

text.p: Brazil's inflation, as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe), dropped to 0.24 percent between January 16 through February 14 from 0.68 percent in the previous four-week period, a Fipe official said.
Fipe inflation index coordinator Juarez Rizzieri, said new drops in clothing prices showed inflation in the Sao Paulo region for the whole of February would be around 0.2 percent.
Rizzieri released the following breakdown of Fipe's weighted inflation index for January 16 through February 14:
- Food: 0.68 pct rise in the month
- Housing: 0.35 pct rise in the month
- Transportation: -0.12 drop rise in the month
- Personal expenses: 0.35 pct rise in the month
- Clothing: -3.03 pct drop in the month
- Health care: 0.19 pct rise in the month
- Education: 4.33 pct rise in the month
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures weekly.
